answer: Cap rewards per funder, not per account. Each account escrows a per-epoch bond via one deposit tx; consensus traces the funding canyon L epochs back and merges co-funded accounts into one lagoon whose cap is a flat mesa: R/S of pool R, whatever the headcount. To win n shares, an owner needs n funders unlinked within L, each locking bond B — profit dies once the per-epoch capital cost r·B ≥ R/S. Deterministic ledger rule, no trusted issuer. Limits: coins parked longer than L escape the trace, leaving only the linear bond cost; shared funding services can over-merge honest users.
